s.note: he eats five dozen eggs every morning
s.how: Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and 20g soft butter until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chives.

s.note: the baker in Belle's village song
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Top each slice with 200g sliced brie and a thin slice of pear from 2 pears. Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg potatoes in the tray. Rest, then make gravy with the pan juices, thyme and 300ml stock. Tear it apart at the table.

w.note: the rose under the glass bell, losing its petals
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar, stir in the gelatine and a few drops of rosewater. Pour into 4 glasses and set 4 hours. Top with 150g raspberries crushed with sugar and a single sugared rose petal.

d.note: the tavern where everyone sings about Gaston
d.how: Freeze 1L cloudy apple juice with the juice of a lemon in a tray, scraping every 30 minutes for 3 hours. Fold 3 tbsp marshmallow creme into 150ml whipped cream and spoon on top. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.
